brand.note: Scoped audit: layout/interaction/component patterns only, for QOR's Admin Panel. Colors and typography below are recorded as evidence of the REFERENCE's own system, not as tokens to adopt — QOR's Admin Panel uses NIGHTLIFE-GV's own color/type tokens (design-system-porpose/design-system.md). See DESIGN_SYSTEM.md before using this file.

referenceSurface.note: Not adopted — recorded only so layout recommendations reference concrete proportions (e.g. '6px flat card'). Use NIGHTLIFE-GV's own surface/color/type tokens for QOR.

sidebar.style: collapsible icon+label vertical nav, chevron on items with sub-menus

topUtilityBar.style: slim, full-width, dismissible strip above sidebar+content split

promoBanner.style: full-width gradient card: illustration + headline + one-line description + single pill CTA

statCardRow.style: large numeric value + colored trend chip (+/-%) + label + directional icon button

donutMetricWidget.style: centered total inside ring + itemized list of contributing rows below

listActivityWidget.style: icon + title/subtitle + relative timestamp + trailing metadata, 'View all' link

statusPillDataTable.style: avatar + name + plain-text columns + colored outline status pill in final column
statusPillDataTable.qorMapping: DIRECT MATCH — venue admin's own event list (draft/published/canceled/ended) AND Super Admin moderation queue (Pending/Active/Suspended/Rejected, ADMIN-08)

carouselWidget.style: prev/next arrow controls over an image strip
carouselWidget.qorMapping: not currently needed by any locked requirement — not adopted

motion.note: MEASURED via a page-wide getComputedStyle scan — transitions applied pervasively (nav items, cards, buttons), not as isolated one-off effects. Exact easing/duration values not individually isolated. Recommendation: use NIGHTLIFE-GV's own easing/duration tokens, but match this reference's BREADTH of what gets a transition.
